## ⚡ Who We Are

**BiomeCore Labs** is an independent systems engineering and software laboratory. We construct high-performance, precision applications and hardware-software bridges that interface native human workflows with biological environments, IoT edge sensors, and local computing enclaves.

We operate under a strict sovereign computing philosophy: software must be **instantaneous, aesthetically uncompromising, fully operable offline, and respectful of personal custody**.

## 🏛️ Our Architectural Non-Negotiables

### 1. 🛡️ Absolute Sovereignty & Zero-Telemetry
We reject forced cloud lock-in, mandatory recurring subscriptions, and external telemetry. Software runs directly on your hardware, stores biological telemetry in sandboxed local databases, and functions 100% offline.

### 2. ⚡ Native Craftsmanship & Fluidity
Engineered natively with **Swift 6, SwiftUI, Metal, and high-frequency WebStation runtimes**. No bloated cross-platform overhead. Fluid 120Hz ProMotion responsiveness, instant launch speeds, and zero lag.

### 3. 🔌 Physical-Digital Hardware Synergy
Direct peer-to-peer integration with laboratory hardware: encrypted Tuya Local LAN sockets, 24/7 LiveKit WebRTC low-latency optical video, Arden Buck psychrometric VPD algorithms, and micro-relays.

### 4. 🎨 Tactical High-Contrast UI
A dark obsidian design language with neon bio-accents, clear typography, intuitive tactile dials, and sterile hands-free Cleanroom Voice operation.

## 🚀 Projects & Releases

### 🍄 [MycoLabs](https://github.com/BiomeCoreLabs/MycoLabs) • *Public Beta v1.0.0*
*The Precision Smart Operating System & Laboratory Station for Cultivators.*
- **Platforms:** iOS 17.6+, iPadOS, macOS, WebStation Suite
- **Core Modules:** Dynamic VPD Microclimate Controller, LiveKit WebRTC 24/7 Optical Feed, Tuya LAN Relays, Cleanroom Voice Console, Genetics Lineage Vault, CVG Field Capacity Scaler, and Thermal AirPrint Barcode Tags.
- **Repository:** [`github.com/BiomeCoreLabs/MycoLabs`](https://github.com/BiomeCoreLabs/MycoLabs)
- **Live Interactive Demo:** [https://biomecorelabs.github.io/MycoLabs/](https://biomecorelabs.github.io/MycoLabs/)

### 🔮 Incubation & Active R&D Pipelines
- **SporeNet Protocol:** Cryptographic ledger and tagging protocol for decentralized mycelial isolations, agar sector records, and spore prints.
- **Cleanroom Vision Spatial HUD:** Hands-free spatial computing interface for sterile laminar flow hoods.
- **BiomeDaemon Micro-Engine:** Ultra-lightweight C/Go micro-telemetry daemon for embedded microcontrollers and edge gateways.
